en.title: Sort Error Codes by Frequency, Then by Value, Ascending
en.description:
Keep every element of the array, sorting first by total number of occurrences in ascending order and, for equal frequencies, by value in ascending order; duplicate values cannot be removed.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, editorial and tests; missing original bounds and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the statement.
en.input: The first line contains n and the second line contains n integers. The original statement only gives the sorting rule, with no value bounds; on this site 0≤n≤200000 and elements are in −10^9..10^9.
en.output: Output the n integers in the required order, separated by spaces; when n=0, output an empty line.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are 3 6 4 4 5 5; 3 2 2 1 1 1; and an empty line, checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Count frequencies, sort all distinct values by (frequency, value), and expand each one by its original frequency.
